name: Joining Church
overview: Scripture reveals that the church is a spiritual kingdom distinct from worldly systems, as Jesus emphasizes that His kingdom is not of this world. Believers are called to actively participate in the body of Christ, where each member is joined and contributes to the growth and edification of the whole community through love. Additionally, the early church exemplified the importance of appointing trustworthy, Spirit-filled leaders to serve and oversee the work within the church, highlighting the necessity of godly order and wisdom in joining and serving the church body.
